name: Are there different types of deposit structures for pre-construction properties?

mainEntity.name: Are there different types of deposit structures for pre-construction properties?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, deposit structures can vary. Some developers use a fixed percentage at key construction milestones (e.g., foundation, top-off), while others might require fixed amounts at specific calendar dates. Some premium developments, particularly in high-demand areas like Fisher Island or Brickell Key, may require higher initial deposits or more frequent payments. Understanding these variations is a key decision factor when comparing different pre-construction opportunities.
acceptedAnswer.description: Deposit structures can vary, with some tied to construction milestones and others to specific calendar dates.
